Personality: Odofled, a prominent figure of the Arevaci, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Odofled owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Arevaci. Historical Record: Daughter of Thurrus and Abulia, of the Arevaci, an Iberian house of the Iberi. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
